pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - New to English
pageCache.text:
New to English
English as an additional language
Celebrating Languages
At the Royal Spa Nursery we embrace and welcome diversity. We are so pleased to have such a wide range of languages spoken by our children as it provides such a rich learning environment.
We provide some mother tongue support for children very new to English through EALTS (English as an Additional Language and Traveller Service).
At nursery we love to celebrate the festivals our children take part in at home and welcome parents in to help with this.
We have a bilingual book lending library.

Special Educational Needs
Some children benefit from extra support and expert advice in order to get the most out of the opportunities for learning and belonging that our nursery affords. We have a Special Needs Coordinator, who will sensitively work with the child and the child’s family, as well as working with professionals to support the child’s next steps.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - Behaviour
pageCache.text:
Behaviour
We have a clear and consistent approach to behaviour. At our nursery we want every child and adult to feel valued and respected and that each person is treated fairly and kindly. We recognise that young children will be learning how to behave and will be at different points in their learning and understanding. Our behaviour policyy aims to help our children grow, be able to recognise their feelings and begin to self-regulate their behaviour.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - Arriving and Leaving
pageCache.text:
Arriving and leaving
All groups have an agreed time to arrive and leave. Please be on time, in order to enable your child to follow the school daily routines and to keep the nursery running smoothly.For the safety of the children staff need to know every person entering the school grounds, please let us know who you are through the intercom and please do not let anyone through the school gate.
Please always make sure the gate is securely shut and bolted after you - this helps to keep your child and all our children safe.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - Parents
pageCache.text:
Parents
Partnership with parents
Click here to link to term dates
We aim to give a very warm welcome to all our families and understand that you know your child the best, their personality, preferences, interests, likes, dislikes, skills and behaviours. We always aim to involve families in their child’s learning and development. We know that your child will benefit hugely if we work in partnership to develop ways to support your child both at home and in nursery. We hope parents will have an ongoing dialogue with us about their child. The beginning and end of session is often a good time for a quick informal chat, but if a more private talk is needed then we can make a mutually convenient time. Throughout the year we have several family events where families can join in and get to know each other. For example:
Also throughout the year we host events to help you with your child’s learning and development. For example:
We always welcome your time in nursery, maybe you have a talent or a skill you could share with the children, for example play an instrument, or tell a story in a language, sharing a festival celebration. Some parents also kindly volunteer some time each week to share stories with children, play board games, mend our books or do some sewing with the children. We always need help with planning fundraising ideas especially our school summer fair. Please let us know if you would be able to help.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - Equalities
pageCache.text:
Equalities
Click here for our equalities policy
We welcome, embrace and celebrate the diversity which exists in our nursery and the wider community. We are committed to ensuring that we have an equality of opportunity for all our children.
We understand that we cannot achieve equality for all by treating everyone the same, we have equal rights but we may have different needs. We are committed to anti discriminatory practice for children, families and staff. We are committed to challenging attitudes that promote discrimination, ensuring respect for all and preparing all our children for life in a diverse society. We publish our Equality objectives in our Equalities policy.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - SUMMER FAIR
pageCache.text:
SUMMER FAIR
This year's Summer Fair is on Saturday 10th July 2027.
Everyone is welcome, £1 entry for adults, children go free.
Our annual Summer Fair is our main fundraising event, the money raised goes towards replacing children's toys & equipment etc.
We welcome help on the day or help with raffle prizes for our fabulous raffle - please get in touch if you'd like to help.
Raffle tickets will be available in advance from the office in June or on the day, £1 each. Bring cash as we don't have card facilities at the nursery.

pageCache.pageTitle: The Royal Spa Nursery School - Snack Money
pageCache.text:
Snack money
Every session they children take a break and sit down with their key groups for snack time to have a drink and eat fruit and crackers.
We ask for a termly contribution towards the children's snack because we do not receive funding for this.
There is a sliding scale, depending on how long your child is here:
15 hour children - £15 per school term
18 hour children (ie, an extra Wednesday morning or afternoon) £18 per school term
30 hour children - £30 per school term
You can pay in cash or direct transfer to the following bank account (please note, this is not the same bank account as for the payment of any fees):
ROYAL SPA NURSERY SCHOOL
Account number: 83845761
Please use your child's name and the word 'SNACK' as a reference.
